This part of the manual explains what is expected
Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Standards

This section sets out how the Companion Animal Travel Desk supports safe, calm, and consistent travel service for animals and their passengers. Staff should use clear language, keep records accurate, and move each case forward with care.

At check-in, staff verify the travel file, confirm the animal is fit to travel, and review any carrier or welfare concerns before the passenger proceeds. <<FACT F086>> The senior coordinator oversees service decisions when a case needs extra review, and the ground team handles carriers with steady attention during transfer between service points. Staff should speak plainly, avoid crowding the passenger, and keep the animal in view whenever practical. Hazel, if present in the service area, should be treated with patience and respect.

For arrival pickup, the desk keeps a close watch on handoff progress and prepares the record for smooth release once the animal is ready. <<FACT F095>> If a pickup does not move as planned, the matter is raised promptly so the team can reduce delay and keep the passenger informed. <<FACT F107>> The welcome team should help the passenger settle, confirm the handoff details, and make sure any care notes are passed along without confusion.

Staff must keep discussions professional, protect personal information, and report any concern about safety, delay, or document mismatch at once. When a case needs clarification, contact the senior coordinator or the duty lead at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
